hero.headline: A place to rest by the
hero.body: Experience comfortable coastal living just 1 km from Mỹ Khê Beach, one of Đà Nẵng's most popular seaside destinations. Our family-run property offers 14 modern 27 m² studio apartments, carefully designed to provide a relaxing and home-like atmosphere — ideal for couples, solo travellers, digital nomads, or long-term guests.

reviews.quote: Perfect location — just 5 minutes on foot to Mỹ Khê beach. The studio was spotless, quiet, and had everything we needed for the full week.
reviews.author: Sarah T.

reviews.quote: Great value and an incredibly responsive host. Modern room, rock-solid WiFi, and the rooftop terrace is a lovely bonus at the end of the day.
reviews.author: Marc D.

reviews.quote: Stayed a full month working remotely. Reliable internet, a practical kitchenette, and the neighbourhood feels safe and local.
reviews.author: James K.

rooms.title: Studios &
rooms.room1_desc: Street-level convenience with direct garage access. Ideal for guests travelling by motorbike or bicycle.
rooms.room2_desc: The perfect balance of privacy and access. Quiet rooms away from street noise, served by elevator.
rooms.room3_desc: Elevated perspectives over the Mỹ An neighbourhood with partial views toward the sea on clear days.
rooms.rooftop_desc: Open-air terrace shared by all guests. City views, drying area, and a perfect spot for sunrise coffee.

amenities.title: Everything you
amenities.body: Each studio at 3H Apartment comes fully equipped so you can settle in immediately. From high-speed WiFi to a private kitchenette, we've thought through the details so you don't have to.
